card.name: Researchers in science news reports
card.fires_on: Words in science news stories that refer to the researchers or the study, such as scientists, researchers, They, Dr, coworkers, or a journal-issue phrase. It also fires on a few other words in popular science articles.

modes.label: Researchers as subject
modes.description: Words naming or standing for the research team, right before a verb about what they did or found.
